{{Infobox |eng = Pale Ale |source = *[[Artisan Goods]] *[[Ginger Island#Island South|Ginger Island Resort]] |buff = {{Name|Tipsy|link=Buffs#Tipsy{{!}}Tipsy}}{{Name|Speed|−1}} |buffduration= 30s |edibility = 20 |sellprice = 300 |ingredients = {{Name|Hops|1}} |craftingstation = {{Name|Keg}} |crafttime = 2250m (37.5h) }} '''Pale Ale''' is an [[Artisan Goods|Artisan Good]] made from the [[Keg]] using [[Hops]], taking 1-2 days. It is also available at the [[Ginger Island#Island South|Ginger Island Resort]] for {{Price|1000}}. [[Pam]] sells Pale Ale in her [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|30|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. When consumed, Pale Ale causes a [[Buffs|Tipsy]] buff that decreases [[Speed]] by 1. ==Aged Values== Pale Ale can be placed inside a [[Cask]] to age from normal quality to silver, gold, and eventually iridium quality. Iridium quality doubles the base sell price of Pale Ale. Normal, silver, and gold quality Pale Ale can be prematurely removed from a cask at any time by striking the cask with an [[Axes|Axe]], [[Hoes|Hoe]], or [[Pickaxes|Pickaxe]]. {| class="wikitable roundedborder" !Normal Quality !Silver Quality

It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *[[Pam]] requests a Pale Ale by mail on the 14th of [[Summer]] in the [[Quests#Pam Is Thirsty|"Pam Is Thirsty" quest]].
